theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an engineering/CAD construction management tool, a high-contrast dark mode ensures precision, clarity, and authority while reducing eye strain during long modeling sessions. Avoids the 'SaaS purple' look.

hierarchy.labels: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-neutral-400 font-mono

rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all dimensions, file sizes, and structural notes.
Use 'Safety Yellow' (#FFCC00) for AI extraction badges and progress bars.
Use 'Blueprint Blue' (#0055FF) for active states, tabs, and primary actions.
No gradients. Flat colors only. Use 1px borders to separate elements.

spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look) - border-collapse style layout, sharp edges.
rules: Go cardless. Use flat rectangular layouts with dense spacing.
Panels should use `border-r border-white/10` rather than floating cards.
Grid children must be direct children.
Mobile images must not exceed max-h-[80vh].

components.buttons: Sharp corners (`rounded-none`). 1px solid border. Hover states lighten the background slightly.
components.badges: Square borders, uppercase mono text (`text-[10px] tracking-wider`), vibrant accent colors.
components.tabs: Override Shadcn tabs to have `rounded-none`. Active tab gets a bottom border of Blueprint Blue or Safety Yellow.
components.forms: Inputs use `rounded-none`, `bg-[#141414]`, 1px border. Focus state outlines in Blueprint Blue.
components.panels: Collapsible side panels for layers/materials with a thin scrollbar. No gutters.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle background brightness increase. DO NOT rely on inheritance (e.g. `hover:bg-[#1E1E1E] hover:text-white`).
motion_and_interaction.progress: Real-time AI pipeline should use a snappy progress bar (width animated) without bouncy easing. Linear and precise.

testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case, role-based. Example: `data-testid='upload-blueprint-button'`, `data-testid='ai-progress-bar'`.

libraries_and_packages.state: Use robust context or zustand for cross-tab real-time sync.
